scenarios.label: Reference date in preceding cycle (November 9, 2026)
scenarios.expected: Previous cycle (-1), ecological day 720, Deep Renewal (season 8), season day 20. Rhythms active, no prologue. No authored microseason profile outside original 200-day coverage.

scenarios.label: Final day before the 2027 epoch
scenarios.expected: Previous cycle (-1), ecological day 800, Deep Renewal day 100. All independent rhythms active. Annual January convergence not yet occurring.

scenarios.label: First day of preceding 800-day cycle
scenarios.expected: Previous cycle (-1), ecological day 1, First Stirring day 1. Epoch anchor remains January 29, 2027.

scenarios.label: Annual January 29 convergence before epoch
scenarios.expected: Great Convergence occurs on the Gregorian date January 29 even before the ecological epoch. Ecological day is determined separately by the 800-day cycle.

scenarios.label: Before the 05:30 daily boundary
scenarios.expected: Ecology day 1; simulated session day 2027-01-28; annual convergence active. No real playback.

scenarios.label: Annual convergence within High Radiance (January 29, 2028)
scenarios.expected: Great Convergence recurs annually, while the independent 800-day ecology is in High Radiance (day 366, season day 66). This is not a reset of the ecological cycle.

scenarios.label: At the 05:30 daily boundary
scenarios.expected: Ecology day 1; simulated session day 2027-01-29; annual convergence active.

scenarios.label: 200-day rhythm restarts
scenarios.expected: Ecology day 201; 200-day rhythm returns to day 1.

scenarios.label: 400-day rhythm restarts
scenarios.expected: Ecology day 401; 400-day rhythm returns to day 1.

scenarios.label: 800-day ecology restarts
scenarios.expected: Ecology day 1 in cycle 2; the independent seven-day rhythm need not match the first day of cycle 1.

scenarios.label: Provisional July convergence diagnostic
scenarios.expected: Provisional event appears only in development mode. July 29 is a test date, not an approved event date.

scenarios.label: Evening-to-night splash-rate test
scenarios.expected: The 19:15 pond is transitioning from evening toward night; splash likelihood rises smoothly to a 1.5× peak at 20:00. The scheduled ripple is deterministic and does not play skipped historical audio.
